capacity_selection.reference: lowest rate maximizing observed successful goodput; abort if all rates have zero goodput
capacity_selection.freeze: algorithm now; measured per-cell references before calibration/validation/test

primary.truth: contiguous complete gateway ledger and final watermark; no polling interpolation
primary.aggregation: mean decisions per episode, mean paired arms per seed, mean seeds
primary.baseline_selection: complete leave-one-arrival-seed-out TRAIN folds; freeze hash before validation
primary.validation_screen: 10% normalized MAE improvement is exploratory only; no statistical pass

brier.event: complete matching HTTP response AND scheduled TTFT <= 0.5s
brier.cohort: all scheduled offers, including admission rejects and errors
brier.prediction_time: no later than client POST; no actual future arrivals/EOS features
brier.censoring: unknown timely incomplete outcomes retain both possible losses

causal_estimand: whole-sequence randomized assignment ITT; later divergent states are not matched
qualification: standard Chat framing/DONE/finish/request-ID and full offered cohort
gateway ledger plus engine running/waiting/orphaned drain, fresh same clock
assignment schedule versus actual CAS application and posting/state-read lag
zero lost trace records/write errors; preserve all failed trials
usage is not token timestamps; native token-event evidence required for TPOT tails
stop_conditions: unsupported identity/clock/tokenizer or unresolved pending action
stale state, failed drain, loss of trace completeness or resource authorization
scout shows insufficient delivered action variation/state support; return unresolved

confirmation.sample_size: choose once from development/pilot paired variance and power; freeze before Test
confirmation.superiority: positive multiplicity-adjusted paired confidence bound on successful goodput
confirmation.equivalence_proposal: TOST 90% CI inside +/-2% relative goodput, plus frozen safety/rejection bounds
